text: SABSEG is SABSEG - Corretor de Seguros, S.A. (Lisbon, NIF 500 906 181), part of Grupo SABSEG, an insurance-broker group founded in late 1999 by four entrepreneurs which says its capital is 100% Portuguese. No individual or institutional shareholder is named on its own pages, and no state link appears.
